| `/contact/` | Desktop | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 0.3 s | 0 | 0 ms | 0.2 s | 0.2 s |

Core Web Vitals thresholds for "good": LCP ≤ 2.5 s, CLS ≤ 0.1, INP ≤ 200 ms.
Lighthouse reports TBT as the lab proxy for INP; 0 ms is the floor.

Full reports: `home-mobile.report.html`, `home-desktop.report.html`. The
remaining pages regenerate with `npm run lh` and are uploaded as CI artefacts on
every push.

### Reproducing

```bash
npm ci
npm run build
npx http-server _site -p 8099 --silent &   # any static server will do
npm run lh                                  # all pages, both profiles
node tools/summarise.js                     # rewrites summary.md
```

Run-to-run variance is worth naming: when all eight runs execute back to back,
the first one absorbs the cold Chrome start and can report an inflated TBT
(200–600 ms) purely from process startup contention on the host. Re-running that
page in isolation reproduces 0 ms every time. The figures above are settled runs.

One further caveat: these are lab runs against a local static server, so
network latency is near zero and LCP is optimistic against a real CDN. The
metrics that carry over unchanged are CLS (0) and TBT (0 ms) — those are
properties of the document, not the connection. Re-run against the deployed URL
via PageSpeed Insights for field-comparable numbers:

```
https://pagespeed.web.dev/analysis?url=<LIVE_URL>
```

PageSpeed Insights also reports CrUX field data once the site has enough real
traffic; a new deployment will show lab data only at first, which is expected
and not a failure.

`tools/psi.js <origin>` automates the same thing across all four pages and
writes `psi-summary.md` alongside the raw responses. Note that the PageSpeed
API's keyless quota is shared across all anonymous callers and is frequently
exhausted (HTTP 429); pass a free API key from the Google Cloud console, or use
the web UI above, which has no such limit.

## How the numbers are achieved

Nothing here is a trick — the page simply does very little.

| Decision | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Static HTML from Eleventy, no client framework | No hydration, no runtime cost |
| CSS inlined into `<head>` (~10 KB) | Zero render-blocking requests; style arrives with the document |
| System font stack, no webfonts | No font request, no FOUT, no swap-induced shift |
| Inline SVG only, no raster images in the layout | Nothing to decode; no `<img>` reflow |
| ~400 bytes of inline JS (nav toggle only) | TBT stays at 0 ms |
| No analytics, tag manager, chat widget or A/B script | No third-party main-thread contention |
| Every sized element has intrinsic dimensions | CLS 0 |
| `aspect-ratio`-free layout using grid/flex with explicit gaps | No late reflow |

Total transferred per page is roughly 25–35 KB of HTML including the inlined CSS.

## Structured data

Validate with the [Rich Results Test](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results)
and the [Schema Markup Validator](https://validator.schema.org/).

| Page | JSON-LD `@graph` nodes |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | Organization, WebSite, WebPage |
| `/product/` | Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage |
| `/pricing/` | Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication (AggregateOffer ₹39,000–₹1,15,000 INR + per-plan Offers), FAQPage |
| `/contact/` | Organization, WebSite, ContactPage, BreadcrumbList |
| `/404.html`, `/thanks/` | Organization, WebSite, WebPage (both `noindex`) |

The graph is generated in `eleventy.config.js` from the same JSON that renders
the visible page, so prices, FAQ text and contact details cannot drift out of
sync with the markup. Every node is linked by `@id` rather than duplicated.

## Structural audit

`npm run check` parses the built HTML and fails the build on: a missing or
overlong `<title>`, a meta description outside 70–170 characters, missing
canonical/OG/Twitter tags, invalid JSON-LD, an `undefined` leaking into the
graph, anything other than exactly one `<h1>`, a skipped heading level, missing
landmarks, a missing skip link, duplicate `id`s, an unlabelled form control, an
`<img>` without `alt` or intrinsic dimensions, an `<svg>` with no accessible
role, a page over 60 KB, or any third-party script.

Current state: 6 pages checked, 0 problems.
